Publish date corroborated by syndicated reprint at el-balad.com/16877945 (dated 2026-03-12).

events.name: Will Graham
events.note: Two-year contract extension signed around the time of his Round 16 2024 Telstra AFL Rising Star nomination, keeping him at Gold Coast "until at least the end of 2027." Confirmed also by AFL.com.au (afl.com.au/news/1162867). No further extension found as of Aug 2026 search, so this remains his current active deal.

events.name: Jake Riccardi
events.note: Re-signed with GWS for a further two years (through 2023), alongside ruckman Matt Flynn. GM of Football Jason McCartney: "We're pleased to extend Matt and Jake for a further two years."

events.name: Jake Riccardi
events.note: Re-signed with GWS for a further three seasons (through 2026), announced at the club's post-match members event following the win over Essendon. Current active contract; as of Aug 2026 he remains uncontracted beyond 2026 with no new deal yet reported.

events.name: Braeden Campbell
events.reporter: Sydney Swans / AAP (via The Canberra Times / The Standard)
events.note: Signed a three-year contract extension in September 2021, tying him to Sydney until at least the end of the 2025 season. He was 19 at the time and already contracted for 2022; this extended him beyond that. Also reported by Sydney Swans official site ('Swans trio re-sign', sydneyswans.com.au/news/1022447) and AFL.com.au.

events.name: Braeden Campbell
events.note: Recommitted to Sydney for a further three seasons, keeping him at the club until at least the end of 2028. Also reported by Sydney Swans official site ('Campbell locked in for three more', sydneyswans.com.au/news/1710124) and AFL.com.au ('Sydney Swans young gun Braeden Campbell among three re-signings', afl.com.au/news/682647). This is his current active contract as of mid-2026 (no further extension found; he returned from a shin stress fracture injury during the 2026 season still under this deal).

events.name: Nathan O'Driscoll
events.note: Signed a two-year contract extension keeping him at Fremantle until at least the end of the 2024 season, after starring in the first half of his debut AFL season. Exact day not published on the article; month estimated from corroborating May/June 2022 coverage (see also AFL.com.au 'Anchored in: Dockers young gun Nathan O'Driscoll re-signs', https://www.afl.com.au/news/772977/anchored-in-dockers-young-gun-nathan-odriscoll-re-signs).

events.name: Nathan O'Driscoll
events.note: Signed a two-year contract extension keeping him at Fremantle until at least the end of the 2026 season, after returning from a blood clot/injury-affected 2024 and playing the final two rounds. This is his current active contract.

events.name: Sam Wicks
events.note: 21-year-old forward signed a two-year extension keeping him at Sydney until at least the end of 2023, after playing all 22 games in 2021. Corroborated by AFL.com.au: https://www.afl.com.au/news/685571/wicks-lit-sydney-swans-fire-up-pressure-forward-sam-wicks-with-fresh-deal

events.name: Sam Wicks

events.note: Signed a three-year extension to the end of 2028, his CURRENT deal, after a breakout switch from forward to half-back under Dean Cox in 2025 (Dennis Carroll Most Improved award). Corroborated by Zero Hanger: https://www.zerohanger.com/transformed-swan-pair-of-first-round-picks-sign-extensions-162234/

events.name: Edward Allan

As of late July/early August 2026, no further extension has been signed - Allan and coach Craig McRae both confirmed contract talks for 2027 are ongoing but unresolved (see https://www.zerohanger.com/collingwood-midfielder-breaks-silence-on-future-180151/ and https://www.zerohanger.com/significant-money-mcrae-addresses-pendlebury-allan-futures-and-collingwoods-trade-plans-180239, both from 24 Jul 2026), so this 2023 extension remains his current contract.

events.name: Sam Clohesy

events.name: Sam Clohesy

events.note: Signed a further two-year extension (alongside Ben Long) taking him through to the end of 2028, off the back of a strong pre-season. Also reported by the club at goldcoastfc.com.au/news/1968563/clohesy-and-long-commit-to-the-coast.

events.name: Changkuoth Jiath

events.name: Changkuoth Jiath

events.name: Jade Gresham

events.name: Jade Gresham
events.note: Signed a four-year contract extension with St Kilda in early May 2019, tying him to the club through the end of the 2023 season. Corroborated by Zero Hanger (https://www.zerohanger.com/rising-saints-star-signs-long-term-deal-29412/, published 2019-05-09).

events.name: Jade Gresham

events.name: Mitch Lewis
